# Rusty Note

A quiet place for **clear thoughts**, *small ideas*, ~~old plans~~ and `inline code`. 구리빛 포인트, 편안한 종이.

[Project notes](https://github.com/mud-the-developer/rusty-note) stay easy to read.

> A copper accent should feel warm; this quieter quote must still be readable.

- [x] Warm paper and charcoal
- [ ] Keep small text and selected text clear

```rust
// copper stays readable on the code surface.
let note = "한국어 and clear text";
```

| Surface | Reading check |
| :--- | :--- |
| Copper accent | Code and selected controls remain legible |
| Warm paper | Dark ink, even when a search match is highlighted |
| Charcoal | Light ink without a bright white glare |
